text: Pinterest, Inc.'s 2026 proxy statement, which says its board follows New York Stock Exchange listing rules, lists four holders of 5% or more of a class of its shares: co-founder and non-executive chair Benjamin Silbermann (46.32% of Class B shares, 35.33% of total voting power), Paul Sciarra (40.90% of Class B shares, 31.19% of total voting power), BlackRock, Inc. (12.01% of Class A shares, 2.85% of total voting power) and The Vanguard Group (12.12% of Class A shares, 2.88% of total voting power).
short: Pinterest's biggest holders are co-founder Benjamin Silbermann and Paul Sciarra, who together have about two thirds of the votes, and the asset managers BlackRock and Vanguard.
